discovery.summary: Assign and configure a concrete Niagara data-interface instance on an emitter module input or system user parameter. Preflights all editable properties before mutation; compiles module overrides and explicitly copies content to runtime and cached default DIs, because array content does not change compile hashes. UE 5.8 only.
whenToUse: Configure an array or spline DI instance for a module input or user parameter.
whenNotToUse: A system editor is open: close that asset editor first.
Runtime component overrides, system-stage modules or placeholder data interfaces.
Edit a non-DI parameter, immutable or transient property.

systemPath.description: Niagara system asset path. The system editor must be closed (SYSTEM_EDITOR_OPEN otherwise).

emitterName.description: Required only with moduleInput. First version supports emitter stacks only.

moduleInput.description: Qualified module input, e.g. HlslDiTest.Arr. Exactly one of moduleInput and userParameter is required; C++ validates the choice.

userParameter.description: System user parameter; accepts Arr or User.Arr. Does not require an emitter.

dataInterfaceType.description: Loaded concrete Niagara DI class, e.g. ArrayFloat or NiagaraDataInterfaceArrayFloat. Module default: declared input class. New user parameter: required. Existing user parameter: exact class only; modules allow a subclass of the declared type.

properties.description: Editable top-level reflected DI properties. All are trial-written to a transient instance before asset mutation. Excludes EditConst, Deprecated and Transient. Soft actor references accept object-path strings. Example: {"FloatData":[1,2,3]}.

save.description: Save after successful compile and runtime/cache sync (omitted: true). Failed compilation/sync leaves unsaved edits in memory. User parameters need no compile.

properties.description: Each property: name, type, value. arrayLengths records path, true length, returnedLength and truncated; each reflected array is capped at 256. Unresolvable links/defaults have valuesAvailable=false and null property values, never invented runtime values.

discovery.summary: Read the mode, linked parameter, concrete class and editable properties of a Niagara module-input or user-parameter DI without creating overrides, compiling or saving. Arrays are capped at 256 and include true lengths. Unresolvable non-user links report null values and valuesAvailable=false. UE 5.8 only.
whenToUse: Inspect an existing DI override, user instance or graph default before editing.
whenNotToUse: A system editor is open: close that asset editor first.
Runtime component overrides, system-stage modules or placeholder data interfaces.
Edit a non-DI parameter, immutable or transient property.
